# netactuate_nke_dns_zones (Data Source)

Reads NKE DNS Zones visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_nke_dns_zones" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The NKE cluster ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `zones` (List of Object) DNS zones attached to the NKE cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (Number)
- `dns_zone_id` (Number)
- `failure_reason` (String)
- `health` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `timestamps` (String)
- `zone` (String)
